§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational everyday vocabulary to advanced conversational fluency, every module is anchored in real moments — from airport check-in to a first job interview, from ordering dinner to a doctor's appointment. Built for learners who want the language ready for wherever the journey takes them.

01

Situation-anchored

Every question reflects a real conversation you'll actually have — at a check-in counter, a restaurant table, or a job interview.

02

Genuinely complete

Travel, dining, shopping, social life, work, health, and school all feature throughout — the full range of everyday English in 2026.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

04

Scenario-led pedagogy

Mini scenarios put you right in the moment — a missed flight, a wrong order, a job interview — so the language actually sticks.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Conversational English Expert

Brice Gadou is an English language specialist dedicated to building practical, real-world training for global learners. Voyage reflects his vision: language learning built for the whole journey — a multiplier of confidence, connection, and ease in every situation.

Designed for learners navigating travel, dining, work, and daily life in English — Voyage is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to travel through life with genuine confidence.
